  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Appends a chain node to the latest valid branch of the partially built tree and updates the branch
   *          to reflect the new tail, using the auto-prune tolerance rules.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If the current branch is empty, set it to [rootNode] and return.
   *   2. Let lastBranchNode = currentBranch.last().
   *   3. If lastBranchNode is an immediate valid next node of the new node (using TreeBuildingStrategy.isImmNext),
   *      call addNodeToTree(node, currentBranch, lastBranchNode).
   *   4. Otherwise, find the nearest ancestor whose level sequence is a proper prefix of node.levelSeq
   *      (searching backward through currentBranch). Attach node as child of that ancestor, then set
   *      currentBranch = path(root -> ancestor -> node).
   * Related Features: addNodeToTree, isImmNext, levelSeq, currentBranch (external state held by buildTree)
   * Related Classes: ChainNode, TreeNode, TreeBuildingStrategy
   * Input:
   *   - node (ChainNode): the incoming parsed heading to be appended.
   *   - currentBranch (List<TreeNode>): the in-progress root-to-leaf path maintained by buildTree, may be empty.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - currentBranch, when non-empty, must represent a valid chain of ancestors from the root TreeNode
   *     whose concatenated level sequences form a prefix-closed sequence.
   *   - node must have a non-null levelSeq.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - The currentBranch is updated so its last element is the tree node created from `node`
   *     (or the merge target when an immediate-next relation is detected and pending nodes are consumed).
   *   - The tree maintained by buildTree is consistent with the new branch.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model currentBranchMany="true"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void addNodeAndUpdateBranch(final ChainNode node, final EList<TreeNode> currentBranch)
  {
    // Step 1: If branch is empty, set to [rootNode] and return
    // Note: In practice, currentBranch is never empty when this is called from buildTree,
    // because it starts with [root]. We handle the edge case anyway.
    if (currentBranch.isEmpty())
    {
      // Caller is expected to have a root node; without root we cannot proceed meaningfully
      return;
    }

    TreeNode lastBranchNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);

    // Step 3: Check if lastBranchNode is an immediate valid next node of the new node
    if (isImmNext(lastBranchNode.getLevelSeq(), node.getLevelSeq()))
    {
      TreeNode[] ref = new TreeNode[] { lastBranchNode };
      addNodeToTree(node, currentBranch, ref);
      return;
    }

    // Step 4: Find nearest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of node.levelSeq
    TreeNode ancestor = null;
    for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
      TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
      EList<Integer> cSeq = candidate.getLevelSeq();
      EList<Integer> nSeq = node.getLevelSeq();
      if (isProperPrefix(cSeq, nSeq))
      {
        ancestor = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (ancestor == null)
    {
      // Fallback: attach under root
      ancestor = currentBranch.get(0);
    }

    // Attach node as child of ancestor
    TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(node);
    ancestor.addChild(newTN);
    newTN.setParent(ancestor);

    // Update currentBranch = path(root -> ancestor -> node)
    // Reconstruct path by walking back from the end until we reach ancestor's index
    int ancestorIndex = -1;
    for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
      if (currentBranch.get(i) == ancestor)
      {
        ancestorIndex = i;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Truncate currentBranch to keep up to ancestor, then add newTN
    if (ancestorIndex >= 0 && ancestorIndex < currentBranch.size() - 1)
    {
      // Remove trailing elements after ancestor
      while (currentBranch.size() - 1 > ancestorIndex)
      {
        currentBranch.remove(currentBranch.size() - 1);
      }
    }
    currentBranch.add(newTN);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Checks whether all chain nodes currently buffered in the pending queue form an immediate
   *          sibling sequence (i.e., each consecutive pair satisfies the immediate-next relation).
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If queue has fewer than 2 elements, return false.
   *   2. For each consecutive pair (a, b) in queue order:
   *        - Compute isImm = isImmNext(a.levelSeq, b.levelSeq).

              newBranch.add(currentBranch.get(i));

              newTN.setParent(ancestor);
              newBranch.add(newTN);

            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();

  /**
   * Helper: check whether seqA is a proper prefix of seqB.
   */
  private boolean isProperPrefix(EList<Integer> seqA, EList<Integer> seqB)
  {
    if (seqA == null || seqB == null)
    {
      return false;
    }
    if (seqA.size() >= seqB.size())
    {
      return false;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < seqA.size(); i++)
    {
      if (!seqA.get(i).equals(seqB.get(i)))
      {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Helper: check whether every consecutive pair in the queue satisfies isImmNext.
   */
  private boolean checkAllImmNextSiblings(Deque<ChainNode> queue)
  {
    if (queue == null || queue.size() < 2)
    {
      return false;
    }
    ChainNode prev = null;
    for (ChainNode node : queue)
    {
      if (prev != null)
      {
        if (!isImmNext(prev.getLevelSeq(), node.getLevelSeq()))
        {
          return false;
        }
      }
      prev = node;
    }
    return true;
  }

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Attaches a parsed chain node to a designated parent in the tree and extends the current branch

   * @generated NOT

  public void addNodeToTree(final ChainNode node, final EList<TreeNode> currentBranch, final TreeNode[] currentNodeRef)
  {
    // Step 1: Create a TreeNode from the chain node
    TreeNode newTreeNode = createTreeNode(node);

    // Step 2: While pending queue is non-empty - merge pending nodes' content into newTreeNode
    // The pending queue is managed by buildTree; per the algorithm the flushing of pending
    // happens in buildTree BEFORE invoking addNodeAndUpdateBranch (which then calls addNodeToTree).
    // When addNodeToTree is invoked from addNodeAndUpdateBranch in the "isImmNext" branch,
    // buildTree has already flushed pending into the chainNode's content, so the queue is empty.
    // When invoked from buildTree's pending-flush path, we also handle merging here as a
    // double-safety step: consume any pending nodes embedded as a side-channel via currentNodeRef[1]
    // is not available, so we rely on buildTree to flush first. This method performs no extra
    // flushing because pending items have already been absorbed into the new TreeNode's
    // content via concatNode during buildTree's flush step.

    // Step 3 & 4: Attach newTreeNode
    if (currentNodeRef == null || currentNodeRef[0] == null || isRoot(currentNodeRef[0]))
    {
      // Attach as child of the root (first element of currentBranch)
      TreeNode root = currentBranch.get(0);
      root.addChild(newTreeNode);
      newTreeNode.setParent(root);
    }
    else
    {
      currentNodeRef[0].addChild(newTreeNode);
      newTreeNode.setParent(currentNodeRef[0]);
    }

    // Step 5: Update currentBranch so its last element is newTreeNode
    currentBranch.add(newTreeNode);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Appends a chain node to the latest valid branch of the partially built tree and updates the branch
   *          to reflect the new tail, using the auto-prune tolerance rules.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If the current branch is empty, set it to [rootNode] and return.
   *   2. Let lastBranchNode = currentBranch.last().
   *   3. If lastBranchNode is an immediate valid next node of the new node (using TreeBuildingStrategy.isImmNext),
   *      call addNodeToTree(node, currentBranch, lastBranchNode).
   *   4. Otherwise, find the nearest ancestor whose level sequence is a proper prefix of node.levelSeq
   *      (searching backward through currentBranch). Attach node as child of that ancestor, then set
   *      currentBranch = path(root -> ancestor -> node).
   * Related Features: addNodeToTree, isImmNext, levelSeq, currentBranch (external state held by buildTree)
   * Related Classes: ChainNode, TreeNode, TreeBuildingStrategy
   * Input:
   *   - node (ChainNode): the incoming parsed heading to be appended.
   *   - currentBranch (List<TreeNode>): the in-progress root-to-leaf path maintained by buildTree, may be empty.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - currentBranch, when non-empty, must represent a valid chain of ancestors from the root TreeNode
   *     whose concatenated level sequences form a prefix-closed sequence.
   *   - node must have a non-null levelSeq.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - The currentBranch is updated so its last element is the tree node created from `node`
   *     (or the merge target when an immediate-next relation is detected and pending nodes are consumed).
   *   - The tree maintained by buildTree is consistent with the new branch.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model currentBranchMany="true"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void addNodeAndUpdateBranch(final ChainNode node, final EList<TreeNode> currentBranch)
  {
    // Step 1: If branch is empty, there's nothing to do (no root context available)
    if (currentBranch.isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }

    // Step 2: lastBranchNode = currentBranch.last()
    TreeNode lastBranchNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);

    // Step 3: If lastBranchNode is an immediate valid next node of the new node
    if (isImmNext(lastBranchNode.getLevelSeq(), node.getLevelSeq()))
    {
      TreeNode[] ref = new TreeNode[] { lastBranchNode };
      addNodeToTree(node, currentBranch, ref);
      return;
    }

    // Step 4: Find nearest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of node.levelSeq
    TreeNode ancestor = null;
    int ancestorIndex = -1;
    for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
      TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
      if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), node.getLevelSeq()))
      {
        ancestor = candidate;
        ancestorIndex = i;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Fallback: attach under root if no proper-prefix ancestor is found
    if (ancestor == null)
    {
      ancestor = currentBranch.get(0);
      ancestorIndex = 0;
    }

    // Attach node as child of ancestor
    TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(node);
    ancestor.addChild(newTN);
    newTN.setParent(ancestor);

    // Truncate currentBranch to keep up to ancestor, then add newTN
    while (currentBranch.size() - 1 > ancestorIndex)
    {
      currentBranch.remove(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    }
    currentBranch.add(newTN);
  }

   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:
   *                   - If isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending) is true, attach all three pending nodes as
   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's
   *                     content, then remove it from the queue.
   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.
   *   6. Return root.
   * Related Features: addNodeAndUpdateBranch, addNodeToTree, createTreeNode, isAllNotImmNodesSiblings,
   *                   isImmNext, levelSeq, pending queue, currentBranch
   * Related Classes: ChainNode, TreeNode, BaseNode
   * Input:

   * Output:

   * Pre-condition:
   *   - Each ChainNode in chain has a well-formed levelSeq list (possibly empty for the synthetic root).
   * Post-condition:
   *   - The returned TreeNode has title "ROOT", levelSeq = [], and a children list whose subtree represents
   *     all headings from `chain`; pending nodes have been merged into content where attachment failed.
   *   - All parent-child links are consistent.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model chainMany="true"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public TreeNode buildTree(final EList<ChainNode> chain)
  {
    // Step 1: handle null or empty chain
    if (chain == null || chain.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode synthetic = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createChainNode();
      synthetic.setTitle("ROOT");
      synthetic.setLevelText("");
      synthetic.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
      synthetic.setContent("");
      return createTreeNode(synthetic);
    }

    // Step 2: Create root synthetic TreeNode
    ChainNode syntheticRoot = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createChainNode();
    syntheticRoot.setTitle("ROOT");
    syntheticRoot.setLevelText("");
    syntheticRoot.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
    syntheticRoot.setContent("");
    TreeNode root = createTreeNode(syntheticRoot);

    // Step 3: Initialize branch and pending queue
    EList<TreeNode> currentBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
    currentBranch.add(root);
    Deque<ChainNode> pending = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>();

    // Step 4: Process each chain node
    for (ChainNode chainNode : chain)
    {
      TreeNode last = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
      if (isImmNext(last.getLevelSeq(), chainNode.getLevelSeq()))
      {
        // Step 4.a.i: Flush pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree
        TreeNode[] lastRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Drain pending into chainNode.content using addNodeToTree semantics
        Deque<ChainNode> snapshot = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>(pending);
        pending.clear();
        // Use a single addNodeToTree call to merge all pending nodes into chainNode
        TreeNode[] currentNodeRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode
        // We need to manually replicate addNodeToTree logic here since it takes one chain node
        // Flush pending nodes into chainNode.content first
        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())
        {
          ChainNode pendingNode = snapshot.pollFirst();
          BaseNode basePending = pendingNode;
          chainNode.concatNode(basePending);
        }
        // Step 4.a.ii: Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() using addNodeAndUpdateBranch
        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();
      }
      else
      {
        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)
        {
          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)
            {
              newBranch.add(n);
            }
            ChainNode[] arr = pending.toArray(new ChainNode[3]);
            for (ChainNode p : arr)
            {
              // Build a temporary branch that ends at the attached node
              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
              {
                branchForAttach.add(n);
              }
              // Attach as child of the last node in the branch (which should be a sibling chain)
              TreeNode attachParent = branchForAttach.get(branchForAttach.size() - 1);
              TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(p);
              if (attachParent == root && isRoot(root))
              {
                root.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {
              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();
          }
          else
          {
            // Merge oldest pending node's content into current branch tail's content, then remove it
            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();
            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Step 5: Merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order
    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    // Step 6: Return root
    return root;
  }

    return node;
  }

   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:
   *                   - If isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending) is true, attach all three pending nodes as
   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's
   *                     content, then remove it from the queue.
   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.
   *   6. Return root.
   * Related Features: addNodeAndUpdateBranch, addNodeToTree, createTreeNode, isAllNotImmNodesSiblings,
   *                   isImmNext, levelSeq, pending queue, currentBranch

   * Output:

   *   - Each ChainNode in chain has a well-formed levelSeq list (possibly empty for the synthetic root).
   * Post-condition:

   *     all headings from `chain`; pending nodes have been merged into content where attachment failed.
   *   - All parent-child links are consistent.

   * @generated NOT

  public TreeNode buildTree(final EList<ChainNode> chain)
  {
    // Step 1: handle null or empty chain
    if (chain == null || chain.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode synthetic = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createChainNode();
      synthetic.setTitle("ROOT");
      synthetic.setLevelText("");
      synthetic.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());

    syntheticRoot.setTitle("ROOT");

    syntheticRoot.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
    syntheticRoot.setContent("");
    TreeNode root = createTreeNode(syntheticRoot);

    // Step 3: Initialize branch and pending queue
    EList<TreeNode> currentBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
    currentBranch.add(root);
    Deque<ChainNode> pending = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>();

    // Step 4: Process each chain node
    for (ChainNode chainNode : chain)
    {
      TreeNode last = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
      if (isImmNext(last.getLevelSeq(), chainNode.getLevelSeq()))
      {
        // Step 4.a.i: Flush pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree
        TreeNode[] lastRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Drain pending into chainNode.content using addNodeToTree semantics
        Deque<ChainNode> snapshot = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>(pending);
        pending.clear();
        // Use a single addNodeToTree call to merge all pending nodes into chainNode
        TreeNode[] currentNodeRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode
        // We need to manually replicate addNodeToTree logic here since it takes one chain node
        // Flush pending nodes into chainNode.content first
        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())

          ChainNode pendingNode = snapshot.pollFirst();

        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();
      }
      else
      {
        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)
        {
          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)

                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)

              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();

            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);

      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);

   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:

   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's
   *                     content, then remove it from the queue.
   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.

        if (pending.size() == 3)

            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();

   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).

   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.

   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).

   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.

   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune

   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).

   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.

            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)
            {
              newBranch.add(n);
            }
            ChainNode[] arr = pending.toArray(new ChainNode[3]);
            for (ChainNode p : arr)
            {
              // Build a temporary branch that ends at the attached node
              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
              {
                branchForAttach.add(n);
              }
              // Attach as child of the last node in the branch (which should be a sibling chain)
              TreeNode attachParent = branchForAttach.get(branchForAttach.size() - 1);
              TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(p);
              if (attachParent == root && isRoot(root))
              {
                root.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {
              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();
          }
          else
          {
            // Merge oldest pending node's content into current branch tail's content, then remove it
            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();
            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Step 5: Merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order
    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    // Step 6: Return root
    return root;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->

  public TreeNode createTreeNode(final ChainNode chainnode)
  {

    return node;
  }

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:
   *                   - If isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending) is true, attach all three pending nodes as
   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's
   *                     content, then remove it from the queue.
   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.
   *   6. Return root.
   * Related Features: addNodeAndUpdateBranch, addNodeToTree, createTreeNode, isAllNotImmNodesSiblings,
   *                   isImmNext, levelSeq, pending queue, currentBranch

  public TreeNode buildTree(final EList<ChainNode> chain)
  {
    // Step 1: handle null or empty chain
    if (chain == null || chain.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode synthetic = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createChainNode();
      synthetic.setTitle("ROOT");
      synthetic.setLevelText("");
      synthetic.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
      synthetic.setContent("");
      return createTreeNode(synthetic);
    }

    // Step 2: Create root synthetic TreeNode
    ChainNode syntheticRoot = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createChainNode();
    syntheticRoot.setTitle("ROOT");
    syntheticRoot.setLevelText("");
    syntheticRoot.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
    syntheticRoot.setContent("");
    TreeNode root = createTreeNode(syntheticRoot);

    // Step 3: Initialize branch and pending queue
    EList<TreeNode> currentBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
    currentBranch.add(root);
    Deque<ChainNode> pending = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>();

    // Step 4: Process each chain node
    for (ChainNode chainNode : chain)
    {
      TreeNode last = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
      if (isImmNext(last.getLevelSeq(), chainNode.getLevelSeq()))
      {
        // Step 4.a.i: Flush pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree
        TreeNode[] lastRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Drain pending into chainNode.content using addNodeToTree semantics
        Deque<ChainNode> snapshot = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>(pending);
        pending.clear();
        // Use a single addNodeToTree call to merge all pending nodes into chainNode
        TreeNode[] currentNodeRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode
        // We need to manually replicate addNodeToTree logic here since it takes one chain node
        // Flush pending nodes into chainNode.content first
        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())
        {
          ChainNode pendingNode = snapshot.pollFirst();
          BaseNode basePending = pendingNode;
          chainNode.concatNode(basePending);
        }
        // Step 4.a.ii: Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() using addNodeAndUpdateBranch
        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();
      }
      else
      {
        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)
        {
          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)
            {
              newBranch.add(n);
            }
            ChainNode[] arr = pending.toArray(new ChainNode[3]);
            for (ChainNode p : arr)
            {
              // Build a temporary branch that ends at the attached node
              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
              {
                branchForAttach.add(n);
              }
              // Attach as child of the last node in the branch (which should be a sibling chain)
              TreeNode attachParent = branchForAttach.get(branchForAttach.size() - 1);
              TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(p);
              if (attachParent == root && isRoot(root))
              {
                root.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {
              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();
          }
          else
          {
            // Merge oldest pending node's content into current branch tail's content, then remove it
            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();
            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Step 5: Merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order
    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    // Step 6: Return root
    return root;
  }

   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:
   *                   - If isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending) is true, attach all three pending nodes as
   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's
   *                     content, then remove it from the queue.
   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.
   *   6. Return root.
   * Related Features: addNodeAndUpdateBranch, addNodeToTree, createTreeNode, isAllNotImmNodesSiblings,
   *                   isImmNext, levelSeq, pending queue, currentBranch
   * Related Classes: ChainNode, TreeNode, BaseNode
   * Input:
   *   - chain (List<ChainNode>): ordered list of parsed headings produced by ChainParser.parseToChain.
   * Output:
   *   - TreeNode: synthetic-rooted outline tree reflecting auto-prune tolerant reconstruction rules.
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - Each ChainNode in chain has a well-formed levelSeq list (possibly empty for the synthetic root).
   * Post-condition:
   *   - The returned TreeNode has title "ROOT", levelSeq = [], and a children list whose subtree represents
   *     all headings from `chain`; pending nodes have been merged into content where attachment failed.
   *   - All parent-child links are consistent.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model chainMany="true"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public TreeNode buildTree(final EList<ChainNode> chain)
  {
    // Step 1: handle null or empty chain
    if (chain == null || chain.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode synthetic = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createChainNode();
      synthetic.setTitle("ROOT");
      synthetic.setLevelText("");
      synthetic.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
      synthetic.setContent("");
      return createTreeNode(synthetic);
    }

    // Step 2: Create root synthetic TreeNode
    ChainNode syntheticRoot = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createChainNode();
    syntheticRoot.setTitle("ROOT");
    syntheticRoot.setLevelText("");
    syntheticRoot.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
    syntheticRoot.setContent("");
    TreeNode root = createTreeNode(syntheticRoot);

    // Step 3: Initialize branch and pending queue
    EList<TreeNode> currentBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
    currentBranch.add(root);
    Deque<ChainNode> pending = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>();

    // Step 4: Process each chain node
    for (ChainNode chainNode : chain)
    {
      TreeNode last = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
      if (isImmNext(last.getLevelSeq(), chainNode.getLevelSeq()))
      {
        // Step 4.a.i: Flush pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree
        TreeNode[] lastRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Drain pending into chainNode.content using addNodeToTree semantics
        Deque<ChainNode> snapshot = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>(pending);
        pending.clear();
        // Use a single addNodeToTree call to merge all pending nodes into chainNode
        TreeNode[] currentNodeRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode
        // We need to manually replicate addNodeToTree logic here since it takes one chain node
        // Flush pending nodes into chainNode.content first
        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())
        {
          ChainNode pendingNode = snapshot.pollFirst();
          BaseNode basePending = pendingNode;
          chainNode.concatNode(basePending);
        }
        // Step 4.a.ii: Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() using addNodeAndUpdateBranch
        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();
      }
      else
      {
        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)
        {
          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)
            {
              newBranch.add(n);
            }
            ChainNode[] arr = pending.toArray(new ChainNode[3]);
            for (ChainNode p : arr)
            {
              // Build a temporary branch that ends at the attached node
              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
              {
                branchForAttach.add(n);
              }
              // Attach as child of the last node in the branch (which should be a sibling chain)
              TreeNode attachParent = branchForAttach.get(branchForAttach.size() - 1);
              TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(p);
              if (attachParent == root && isRoot(root))
              {
                root.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {
              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();
          }
          else
          {
            // Merge oldest pending node's content into current branch tail's content, then remove it
            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();
            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Step 5: Merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order
    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    // Step 6: Return root
    return root;
  }

   * Summary: Creates a fresh TreeNode whose fields are populated from a ChainNode's data.

    return node;

   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.

   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):

   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:

        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode
        // We need to manually replicate addNodeToTree logic here since it takes one chain node
        // Flush pending nodes into chainNode.content first
        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())

          BaseNode basePending = pendingNode;
          chainNode.concatNode(basePending);

        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();
      }
      else
      {
        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)

          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {

            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)

              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))

                newTN.setParent(attachParent);

              newBranch = branchForAttach;

                    Long value = Utils.chineseToInt(text);
                    return value != null ? value.intValue() : 0;
                }
                case LETTER:
                    return (int) text.charAt(0) - (int) 'A' + 1;
                case CIRCLED:
                    return (int) text.charAt(0) - (int) '\u2460' + 1;
                default:
                    return null;
            }
  }

} // ParserHelper

   *          any chain that does not begin at the root or violates parent-child extension is rejected.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).

   *          any chain that does not begin at the root or violates parent-child extension is rejected.

   *          any chain that does not begin at the root or violates parent-child extension is rejected.

   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).

- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:
   *                   - If isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending) is true, attach all three pending nodes as
   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's
   *                     content, then remove it from the queue.
   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.
   *   6. Return root.
   * Related Features: addNodeAndUpdateBranch, addNodeToTree, createTreeNode, isAllNotImmNodesSiblings,
   *                   isImmNext, levelSeq, pending queue, currentBranch
   * Related Classes: ChainNode, TreeNode, BaseNode
   * Input:

   * Output:

   * Pre-condition:
   *   - Each ChainNode in chain has a well-formed levelSeq list (possibly empty for the synthetic root).
   * Post-condition:
   *   - The returned TreeNode has title "ROOT", levelSeq = [], and a children list whose subtree represents

   *   - All parent-child links are consistent.

   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();

        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue

            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();

                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {

            }
            pending.clear();

            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();

            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);

    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    return root;

      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)
        {
          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)
            {
              newBranch.add(n);
            }
            ChainNode[] arr = pending.toArray(new ChainNode[3]);
            for (ChainNode p : arr)
            {
              // Build a temporary branch that ends at the attached node
              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
              {
                branchForAttach.add(n);
              }
              // Attach as child of the last node in the branch (which should be a sibling chain)
              TreeNode attachParent = branchForAttach.get(branchForAttach.size() - 1);
              TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(p);
              if (attachParent == root && isRoot(root))
              {
                root.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {
              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();
          }
          else
          {
            // Merge oldest pending node's content into current branch tail's content, then remove it
            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();
            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Step 5: Merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order
    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    // Step 6: Return root
    return root;
  }

   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.

   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.

   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:

   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's

   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.

    syntheticRoot.setContent("");
    TreeNode root = createTreeNode(syntheticRoot);

    // Step 3: Initialize branch and pending queue
    EList<TreeNode> currentBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
    currentBranch.add(root);
    Deque<ChainNode> pending = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>();

    // Step 4: Process each chain node
    for (ChainNode chainNode : chain)
    {
      TreeNode last = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
      if (isImmNext(last.getLevelSeq(), chainNode.getLevelSeq()))

        TreeNode[] lastRef = new TreeNode[] { last };

        pending.clear();

        TreeNode[] currentNodeRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode

        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())

        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);

        pending.clear();

      else

        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)

          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }

            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();

            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)

              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)

                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else

                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;

            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)

              currentBranch.add(n);

            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);

    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    return root;

   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:
   *              i.   Push chainNode onto the pending queue.
   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:
   *                   - If isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending) is true, attach all three pending nodes as
   *                     immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor (in queue order), updating
   *                     currentBranch to end at the last attached node.
   *                   - Else, merge the oldest pending node's content into the current branch tail's
   *                     content, then remove it from the queue.
   *   5. After the loop, merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order.

  {
    // Step 1: handle null or empty chain
    if (chain == null || chain.isEmpty())

      synthetic.setTitle("ROOT");
      synthetic.setLevelText("");
      synthetic.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());

    syntheticRoot.setLevelText("");
    syntheticRoot.setLevelSeq(new BasicEList<Integer>());
    syntheticRoot.setContent("");
    TreeNode root = createTreeNode(syntheticRoot);

    // Step 3: Initialize branch and pending queue
    EList<TreeNode> currentBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
    currentBranch.add(root);
    Deque<ChainNode> pending = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>();

    // Step 4: Process each chain node
    for (ChainNode chainNode : chain)
    {
      TreeNode last = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
      if (isImmNext(last.getLevelSeq(), chainNode.getLevelSeq()))

        TreeNode[] lastRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Drain pending into chainNode.content using addNodeToTree semantics
        Deque<ChainNode> snapshot = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>(pending);
        pending.clear();
        // Use a single addNodeToTree call to merge all pending nodes into chainNode
        TreeNode[] currentNodeRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode

        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())

          ChainNode pendingNode = snapshot.pollFirst();
          BaseNode basePending = pendingNode;
          chainNode.concatNode(basePending);

        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();
      }
      else

        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)

          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)
            {
              newBranch.add(n);
            }
            ChainNode[] arr = pending.toArray(new ChainNode[3]);
            for (ChainNode p : arr)
            {
              // Build a temporary branch that ends at the attached node
              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
              {
                branchForAttach.add(n);
              }
              // Attach as child of the last node in the branch (which should be a sibling chain)
              TreeNode attachParent = branchForAttach.get(branchForAttach.size() - 1);
              TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(p);
              if (attachParent == root && isRoot(root))
              {
                root.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {
              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();

            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();
            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);

    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    return root;

   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:

   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:

        if (pending.size() == 3)

            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();

              newBranch = branchForAttach;

   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:

   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:

            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();

              newBranch = branchForAttach;

   * Summary: Constructs the full document outline tree from a chain of heading nodes using the auto-prune
   *          tolerant strategy that recovers from irregular level jumps and handles a bounded pending queue.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If chain is null or empty, return a synthetic TreeNode titled "ROOT" with levelSeq = [].
   *   2. Create root = createTreeNode(syntheticChainNode("ROOT", [])).
   *   3. Initialize currentBranch = [root], pending = empty deque.
   *   4. For each chainNode in chain (in order):
   *        a. If chainNode is an immediate valid next node of currentBranch.last() (using isImmNext):
   *              i.   Flush the pending queue into chainNode.content via addNodeToTree in arrival order.
   *              ii.  Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() (or root if at root) using addNodeAndUpdateBranch.
   *              iii. Clear pending.
   *        b. Else:

   *              ii.  If pending.size() == 3:

        Deque<ChainNode> snapshot = new ArrayDeque<ChainNode>(pending);
        pending.clear();
        // Use a single addNodeToTree call to merge all pending nodes into chainNode
        TreeNode[] currentNodeRef = new TreeNode[] { last };
        // Call addNodeToTree to flush all pending nodes into chainNode
        // We need to manually replicate addNodeToTree logic here since it takes one chain node
        // Flush pending nodes into chainNode.content first
        while (!snapshot.isEmpty())
        {
          ChainNode pendingNode = snapshot.pollFirst();
          BaseNode basePending = pendingNode;
          chainNode.concatNode(basePending);
        }
        // Step 4.a.ii: Attach chainNode under currentBranch.last() using addNodeAndUpdateBranch
        addNodeAndUpdateBranch(chainNode, currentBranch);
        // Step 4.a.iii: Clear pending
        pending.clear();
      }
      else
      {
        // Step 4.b.i: Push chainNode onto pending queue
        pending.addLast(chainNode);

        // Step 4.b.ii: When pending queue size reaches 3
        if (pending.size() == 3)
        {
          if (isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(pending))
          {
            // Attach all three pending nodes as immediate siblings under the nearest suitable ancestor
            // Find the nearest suitable ancestor based on the first pending node's levelSeq
            ChainNode firstPending = pending.peekFirst();
            TreeNode ancestor = root;
            // Find deepest ancestor whose levelSeq is a proper prefix of firstPending.levelSeq
            for (int i = currentBranch.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
              TreeNode candidate = currentBranch.get(i);
              if (isProperPrefix(candidate.getLevelSeq(), firstPending.getLevelSeq()))
              {
                ancestor = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            // Attach all three pending nodes in queue order
            EList<TreeNode> newBranch = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
            // Copy path from root to ancestor
            TreeNode[] pathToAncestor = findPath(root, ancestor);
            for (TreeNode n : pathToAncestor)
            {
              newBranch.add(n);
            }
            ChainNode[] arr = pending.toArray(new ChainNode[3]);
            for (ChainNode p : arr)
            {
              // Build a temporary branch that ends at the attached node
              EList<TreeNode> branchForAttach = new BasicEList<TreeNode>();
              for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
              {
                branchForAttach.add(n);
              }
              // Attach as child of the last node in the branch (which should be a sibling chain)
              TreeNode attachParent = branchForAttach.get(branchForAttach.size() - 1);
              TreeNode newTN = createTreeNode(p);
              if (attachParent == root && isRoot(root))
              {
                root.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(root);
              }
              else
              {
                attachParent.addChild(newTN);
                newTN.setParent(attachParent);
              }
              branchForAttach.add(newTN);
              // Replace newBranch with branchForAttach
              newBranch = branchForAttach;
            }
            // Replace currentBranch with newBranch
            currentBranch.clear();
            for (TreeNode n : newBranch)
            {
              currentBranch.add(n);
            }
            pending.clear();
          }
          else
          {
            // Merge oldest pending node's content into current branch tail's content, then remove it
            ChainNode oldest = pending.pollFirst();
            TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
            tailNode.concatNode(oldest);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Step 5: Merge any remaining pending nodes into currentBranch.last().content in arrival order
    TreeNode tailNode = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    while (!pending.isEmpty())
    {
      ChainNode remaining = pending.pollFirst();
      tailNode.concatNode(remaining);
    }

    // Step 6: Return root
    return root;
  }
